title: The best anti-procrastinating app
body:
The app works as a portal to a world called Habitica in which you create a character that levels up while you do tasks, to-dos and habits. In return, all mentioned before help you complete search and fighting quests from which you receive various rewards (exp., gold, eggs, equipment, etc.). The more you use it, the more you get. 

From my point of view, this is the best app I have ever used to push you to do your dailies, to dos and habits, all in one place. If you are in a party with at least one other enthusiast, you do a lot of real time activity/tasks in order to gain levels, coins and rewards! I recommend this to anyone who loves to play games, procrastinates but wants to quit and anyone that loves a challenge. 

The only things I really miss (since the new update really changed the app in a good way) is the option to buy the diamonds with coins (for subscribers) in the app, damage dealt to the boss under boss’ life left and when I click to-dos I lose life if there are many done at once. 

Thank you Habitica team for this app!
author: Namgyel
